{{Top|leg}}
The '''Desolation''' was a barren and lifeless region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]]. It was located on the planet's north pole and was circular in shape, with a radius of about 100 kilometers. It was formed thousands of years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the byproducts of metals used by the [[Caarite]]s killed off all the life there.
